text: ここで　ボールを　なげるんだね　ぼく……　やってみるよ！

structure.jp: ここで　ボールを　なげるんだね
structure.en: you throw the Ball here, right?

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a て-form means to try doing something. やってみる = 'try doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ adds a tone of explaining or checking, and ね asks for agreement. なげるんだね = 'so you throw it, right?'.
